notes: Authoritative classification of every PRD through PRD-049 for v1.0.0 release. classification: one of core-v1 | optional-profile | historical | deferred | superseded | draft. required_for_minimal_profile: boolean; true only for core-v1 entries that a fresh v1 adopter MUST read. profile: named optional profile (or null). v1_surface: short human-readable reason. PRD-025 is recorded as superseded because it was never registered in PRD_STATUS.json. Maintainer 2026-06-23 OQ-043-1 ruling: skills are a core requirement of FULL Turnfile participation; agents without skill bundles may participate at a LESSER (v1-minimal) tier. Tiered conformance encoded via required_for_full_participation field per entry: true for the skill-bundle profile (PRD-012, PRD-033) plus all core-v1 entries; false for everything else. v1-minimal conformance requires only required_for_minimal_profile=true entries. PRD-045 is the multi-agent-resilience optional profile and is required for full multi-agent participation, not for v1-minimal starter adoption. PRD-046 records the archive boundary as historical/provenance support, PRD-047 remains draft release-evidence work until Maintainer dogfood evidence ratification lands, PRD-048 is the portable CLI entry point for the v1 operational surface, and PRD-049 is an optional same-family multi-instance collaboration profile.

prds.v1_surface: Maintainer interaction model is the authority spine encoded in SPEC §3.
Rust notification viewer MVP archived; not a protocol contract.
Message lifecycle and SLA contract — the five-state mailbox model encoded in MINIMUM_VIABLE_TURNFILE.md.
Maintainer decision contract — the decision-record fields encoded in SPEC §8.
Protocol data schema and compatibility — frozen as schemas/v1/turnfile-v1.schema.json.
Apply-or-counter review envelope encoded in SPEC §7; the A1 loop is the v1 default review path.
Trust and provenance layer is an evidence-quality enhancement above the core mailbox/worklog evidence model.
Cross-sandbox payload-first handoff is needed only when agents run in separate filesystems; single-host v1 sessions do not require it.
Cross-document reconciliation — the OQ triage and consistency rules that keep TURNFILE/MAILBOX/WORKLOG in agreement.
Shared-file transaction locking — revision-based lease behavior encoded in SPEC §5.
Session resumption read order is a boot-time aid; v1 minimal sessions can resume from the three core files directly.
Per-agent skill bundles are out of scope for v1 minimal; bundle integrity is the skill-bundle-integrity profile.
Turnfile coordination format — TURNFILE.yaml shape encoded in SPEC §5 and schemas/v1.
Session closeout + boot handoff contract — encoded as the close protocol in MINIMUM_VIABLE_TURNFILE.md.
Agent onboarding and vetting — needed only when adding new agents to an existing session; v1 minimal sessions name agents at open.
Session rotation trigger contract addresses long-running sessions; v1 minimal sessions can close and re-open without it.
Boot sequence commands and documentation contract is a boot-simplification enhancement.
Approval authority matrix is a delegation-band enhancement above the core authority order.
Mailbox-first polling cadence is a coordination-style enhancement; v1 minimal sessions can use any polling cadence.
Boot artifact completeness and chat log contract is a boot-simplification enhancement.
Conflict loop bound and selective-unlock gradient is a refinement over the core authority order; v1 minimal sessions can use single-round apply-or-counter.
Decision-mirror delivery is a notification enhancement over the core mailbox.
Out-of-band activity reconciliation is a multi-runtime aid; single-runtime v1 sessions do not require it.
Human-legibility invariant and encoding profiles is a Tokenese-adjacent contract.
Never registered; gap in PRD numbering preserved for audit.
Review cycle closure and task-state consistency is an automation enhancement above the core close protocol.
Tokenese cloned-communication A/B contract is the Tokenese-profile entry point.
Tokenese dual-artifact sync and maintainer legibility is part of the Tokenese profile.
Pre-write state derivation is a concurrent-shards-adjacent contract.
Session heartbeat management is the heartbeat-profile entry point.
Concurrent multi-agent coordination is the concurrent-shards profile.
Session orientation tool is part of the boot-simplification profile.
Skill ownership integrity guard is part of the skill-bundle-integrity profile.
Public and agent-facing surface snapshot reconciliation is the public-surface-snapshot profile.
Tokenese integration and upstream result sync is part of the Tokenese profile.
PRD eval runner is a CI enhancement; v1 minimal sessions can run focused node --test invocations directly.
Boot simplification is the boot-simplification-profile entry point.
Read-only heartbeat stewards are part of the heartbeat profile.
Perplexity Computer onboarding deltas is part of the onboarding profile.
Heartbeat loop prompt is part of the heartbeat profile.
Unified terminal transport and deterministic projection is the unified-terminal-transport profile.
Qwen 3.6 35b MLX onboarding deltas is part of the onboarding profile.
This PRD defines the Minimum Governance Profile itself; required reading is its outputs (SPEC.md + MINIMUM_VIABLE_TURNFILE.md + CONFORMANCE.md + DEFINITIONS.md), not the PRD body.
Handshake-sign CLI argument ergonomics is a v1 polish item; the JSON payload mode satisfies core conformance.
Stale-agent reconciliation is required for robust multi-agent operations but not for single-agent v1-minimal starter adoption.
Repo minimization archive preserves development history and archive boundaries; fresh adopters use the current stable surface instead.
Cross-repo validation tests are release evidence for v1.0.0, not required reading for a fresh v1 adopter.
Portable CLI is the v1 operational entry point for init/open/status/heartbeat/close; fresh adopters can use the CLI without reading historical PRDs.
Same-family multi-instance collaboration is an optional profile for concurrent sibling models in one provider family; it does not change v1-minimal required reading or reviewer independence.

tiers.v1-minimal: Lesser-level participation. Requires only entries with required_for_minimal_profile=true. No skill bundles needed. Suitable for agents whose runtime does not load skill bundles.
tiers.v1-full: Full Turnfile participation. Requires v1-minimal plus all entries with required_for_full_participation=true (notably the skill-bundle profile via PRD-012/PRD-033). Required for agents that contribute to PRD authorship, eval authoring, or required-reviewer roles.
